Name: smallcopper's icons
Author: smallcopper
Description:
hello! this is my first mod, i made this for myself to start with and then thought, eh, why not post it haha. all it does is change the little relationship indicator icon thingy on the dialogue screen :) 

there's a couple of options, i may end up adding more with updates or i may not idk. anyway currently there are five available: moon phases, flowers, fruits, gemstones and pastel-coloured hearts.

you can change them in the config file once you've loaded the game once.

requires content patcher and it's made to (kind of) work with vintage interface!

pls do lmk if there's anything glitchy going on/anything that could be improved or changed!! ty for being here haha <3
